audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Dr. Mundo Level 6, First item and 2+ items and marked Levels 3 and 4-5 as Skill. The packet chart and the matchup's own prose say K'Sante owns everything except a single Level 3 window.
audit.why: whys[2] describes a Level 3 shove-and-sustain window and whys[3..6] hand every later stage to K'Sante; the packet chart agrees. All Out's shred and healing beat Mundo's HP stacking, so Mundo never re-takes the lane.
audit.corrected: K'Sante, K'Sante, Dr. Mundo (Level 3 only), K'Sante, K'Sante, K'Sante, K'Sante — ratings 3/4/6/4/4/4/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] omitted that All Out grants healing, and no field told you to buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's R text grants increased damage AND healing while All Out; the missing-interactions file flags needs-antiheal for exactly this. Without anti-heal his sustain out-paces Maximum Dosage.
audit.corrected: State the healing and put Grievous Wounds before item two.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ntofo Strikes described as a 'third-hit knock-up'. Blunt Force Trauma called 'Blunt Force'. Footwork (E) never mentioned. All Out cooldown listed as 90s.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes fires a shockwave that PULLS at 2 stacks, not a knock-up at 3. All Out is 120/100/80s. Footwork is a dash plus shield on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s that absorbs your commit. Path Maker takes reduced damage while charging and its knockback/stun disappears while All Out.
audit.corrected: Name the pull correctly, use All Out's real 120s rank-1 cooldown, and tell the player to force Footwork's shield out before committing. Your passive eats the first immobilize — spend it on the Path Maker stun, not the Q pull.

audit.why: 50.52% over 1144 games; the prose already frames it as a rough coin-flip that K'Sante edges.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while All Out is up.
edits.after: Your one window: full kit, and your passive eats his first immobilize. Poke with Infected Bonesaw, shove, and take the CS lead before his Q stacks come online.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. K'Sante must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: Path Maker (W) takes reduced damage while charging, then stuns — trading into a charge is free value for him. Poke on Q's 4s cooldown and refuse the extended fight.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force K'Sante to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: All Out (120s at rank 1) gives him shred, damage and healing at once — it out-paces Maximum Dosage. Disengage on the transform and come back when the 120s is spent.

edits.before: Heartsteel timing — every proc widens the HP gap and your cleavers start hurting. Stand in the wave and dare K'Sante to trade into the regen.
edits.after: Heartsteel widens the HP gap, but All Out's shred and Path Maker's true damage read straight through it. Buy Grievous Wounds here or his healing wins the duel.

edits.before: Warmog's makes you a raid boss: full HP between every fight. K'Sante needs Grievous Wounds and a jungler to even slow you down — split, soak, win.
edits.after: Warmog's keeps you full between fights, but All Out shred and Path Maker true damage still win his duel. Play frontline for your team; do not solo-split into him.

edits.before: At level 2 his stacking Q toward a knock-up keeps him ahead in trades.
edits.after: At level 2 his Ntofo Strikes stacks into a pull that keeps him ahead.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his W Path Maker and Q shred re-take the trading edge.
edits.after: Through 4-5 Path Maker charges through damage, then stuns you flat.

edits.before: You get a brief window at 3 — Q Infected Bonesaw shove and sustain lets you contest CS — but his Q Ntofo Strikes stacks into a knock-up and his W Path Maker true-damage tank-shred still out-trades you most levels.
edits.after: You get a brief window at 3 — Infected Bonesaw (Q) is a 4s cooldown, so shove and contest CS — but two Ntofo Strikes stacks fire a shockwave that pulls you in, and Path Maker's true damage out-trades you after.

edits.before: His R All Out is the problem: it strips his own resistances and shreds yours, turning him into a lethal duelist who percent-shreds your armor and out-damages your R Maximum Dosage healing.
edits.after: His R All Out is the problem: 120s at rank 1, it strips his own resistances but grants damage, shred AND healing — buy Grievous Wounds before item two or his sustain out-lasts Maximum Dosage.

edits.before: K'Sante scales as a bruiser-tank and his W Path Maker charge plus R shred beat your regen; his true and percent damage ignores your HP stacking and out-sustains you in extended trades.
edits.after: Footwork (E) is a dash plus shield on an 8s cooldown at rank 5 — it eats your burst window, so force it out first. Path Maker's true damage ignores every point of armour you bought.

edits.before: Dodge his Q Ntofo Strikes third-hit knock-up
edits.after: Dodge the second Ntofo Strikes stack — it pulls

edits.before: Stack Q Ntofo Strikes for the knock-up and out-trade you
edits.after: Stack Q Ntofo Strikes for the pull-in, then stun you

edits.before: Charge W Path Maker to wall you and win the tank duel
edits.after: Footwork shields his burst, then Path Maker stuns you

edits.before: Extend into his W block — that is the exchange K'Sante wins flat.
edits.after: Trade into a charging Path Maker — he takes reduced damage.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out (90s): matchup-defining — His duelist mode. While down, you out-sustain. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out (120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3): his duelist mode — while it is down you out-sustain him. - Footwork (10s at rank 1): the shield eats your commit, so bait it. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.

edits.before: Track K'Sante’s All Out (90s): His duelist mode. While down, you out-sustain. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track All Out (120s at rank 1): his duelist mode, with healing attached. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: K’Sante tanks your cleavers and his R turns him into a duelist. Dodge his Q, out-sustain his poke, and don’t fight his R form blindly. Track All Out before every step-up.
edits.after: K’Sante tanks your cleavers and All Out turns him into a duelist. Two Ntofo Strikes stacks pull you in — break line of sight after the first. Level 3 is your one shove window.

notes: Level chart flipped to the packet and to its own prose: K'Sante everywhere except a single Level 3 window for Mundo. Real corrections: Ntofo Strikes pulls at 2 stacks (it was written as a third-hit knock-up), All Out is 120/100/80s (it was written as 90s), and Footwork's shield was never mentioned anywhere. Grievous Wounds is now called for — All Out grants healing. All before-strings copied verbatim from currentText.
